purpose: Regression prompts for PM Desk triggering, work-mode selection and single-file section routing.

cases.prompt: 帮我判断这个功能值不值得做
cases.notes: Use the judgment lens internally; do not print a full checklist.

cases.prompt: 这个需求延期了，帮我想想怎么跟客户说
cases.notes: Give sendable wording first and avoid a communication-method lecture.

cases.prompt: 先别套常规方案，帮我发散三个完全不同的会员增长机制，再判断哪个值得验证
cases.notes: Preserve divergent thinking before converging on a test.

cases.prompt: 先来一版会员等级的 PRD 草稿
cases.notes: Use concentrated assumptions and placeholders for core unknowns.

cases.prompt: 把这个 PRD 正式落文件，并补版本记录
cases.notes: Confirm the target/source if absent, then write and verify the file.

cases.prompt: 企业月结这种能力一般怎么设计？
cases.notes: Generic wording is not a source signal; examples remain generic.

cases.prompt: 我刚接手一堆资料，先帮我看看怎么整理
cases.notes: Identify entry and gaps first; do not move files automatically.

cases.prompt: 下面是会议转写，帮我整理纪要
cases.notes: Decisions and actions first; do not infer owner/date.

cases.prompt: 这条经验记到 Obsidian，先给我路径、摘要和双链建议
cases.notes: Propose only and wait before writing.

cases.prompt: 帮我做一个汇报 PPT 的核心叙事和关键页
cases.notes: Define audience outcome and narrative; do not create a file unless asked.

cases.prompt: 把确认后的方案直接做成正式 PPTX，按我的工作台风格交付
cases.notes: Use the presentation workflow and PM Desk visual baseline when no user deck exists.

cases.prompt: 先出一版后台订单列表的 HTML 原型页面
cases.notes: Copy the sole master and design the list page to the task.

cases.prompt: 继续极致优化我的 PM Desk skill，但不要发布
cases.notes: Edit the source only, keep one Markdown and run validation.

cases.prompt: review 这段 TypeScript 代码有没有 bug
分析这个 CSV，给我画趋势图和异常点
只修改这个 Word 文件的页边距和批注格式
cases.notes: Use the document-format workflow unless PM content judgment is also requested.
